meta.name: receiving-code-review
meta.description: Use when receiving code review feedback, before implementing suggestions, especially if feedback seems unclear or technically questionable - requires technical rigor and verification, not performative agreement or blind implementation

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审慎处理代码审查反馈，验证后再实施
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果收到代码审查意见时想先验证再修改
copy.tagline_en: Handle code review feedback with verification before implementation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to verify code review suggestions before implementing them

howto.what: 收到代码审查反馈后，Claude 会先完整阅读、理解并验证每条建议的技术正确性，然后才决定是否实施。它会避免空洞的感谢或表演性同意，而是用技术性回应或直接行动来确认。
howto.when: 当 Claude 收到代码审查反馈（来自人类伙伴或外部审查者），且反馈内容不清晰或技术上可疑时触发。

say.text: 我理解了第1、2、3、6条，但第4和第5条需要澄清后再实施。
say.note: Claude 会暂停实施，等待澄清。

say.text: 已修复。将错误ID更正为正确值。
say.note: Claude 直接实施并简要说明改动。

howto.what_en: When receiving code review feedback, Claude reads all feedback without reacting, restates requirements, verifies against the codebase, evaluates technical soundness, then responds with technical acknowledgment or reasoned pushback, implementing one item at a time with testing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude receives code review feedback from a human partner or external reviewer, especially if feedback is unclear or technically questionable.

say_en.text: I understand items 1,2,3,6. Need clarification on 4 and 5 before proceeding.
say_en.note: Claude stops and waits for clarification.

say_en.text: Fixed. Corrected the bundle ID to the right value.
say_en.note: Claude implements and states the fix.
